preconditions.description: The number of nodes n and operations m are at least 1.
There are exactly n-1 edges defining the tree structure.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints are valid distinct node indices within the range [1, n].
There are exactly m operations provided.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in ops)
preconditions.description: All operation parameters a and b are valid distinct node indices within the range [1, n].
The given edges form a valid undirected tree rooted at node 1.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers corresponding to nodes 1 through n.

postconditions.expression: all(c_i == sum(1 for j in range(1, n + 1) if j != i and has_common_number(i, j, ops, subtree_map)) for i, c_i in enumerate(output_values, start=1))
postconditions.description: For each node i, the output value c_i equals the count of distinct nodes j (where j != i) such that the set of operation indices added to node i and the set of operation indices added to node j have a non-empty intersection.
The stdout text is the space-separated string representation of the computed counts.
